sentences.l2: 人们谈起人工智能，往往惊叹于算法的精妙，却很少留意其背后默默耕耘的庞大群体。
sentences.l1: When people talk about artificial intelligence, they are often amazed by the ingenuity of algorithms, but rarely notice the huge group quietly toiling behind it.

sentences.l2: 机器之所以能够识别图像、理解语言，是因为它们“学习”了海量经过整理的训练数据，而这些数据依赖数据标注员日复一日的手工劳动：他们在屏幕前为照片中的行人画框，给语音转写文字，判断一段评论的情感倾向。
sentences.l1: The reason machines can recognize images and understand language is that they have "learned" from massive amounts of organized training data, and this data depends on the day-after-day manual labor of data annotators: in front of their screens they draw boxes around pedestrians in photos, transcribe speech into text, and judge the emotional tendency of a comment.

sentences.l2: 为了降低成本、加快进度，许多企业采用众包模式，将任务拆解后分发给世界各地的兼职者。
sentences.l1: To reduce costs and speed up progress, many companies adopt the crowdsourcing model, breaking tasks down and distributing them to part-timers around the world.

sentences.l2: 报酬按件计算，一条往往只值几分钱。
sentences.l1: Pay is calculated per item, and one item is often worth only a few cents.

sentences.l2: 与此同时，为了确保数据准确，平台还设有严格的质量控制机制，例如多人交叉核对、抽查复审，错误率偏高者会被扣薪甚至清退。
sentences.l1: At the same time, to ensure data accuracy, platforms also have strict quality control mechanisms, such as cross-checking by multiple people and spot-check reviews, and those with a high error rate will have their pay docked or even be dismissed.

sentences.l2: 可见，智能的光环之下，隐藏着理应被尊重的“看不见”的劳动。
sentences.l1: It can be seen that beneath the halo of intelligence hides "invisible" labor that ought to be respected.
